name: Dora Dobrotić — a son Jacobus baptised in 1871, Križovljan Radovečki, Croatia
researcher_question: Which children were born to Dora (Dorothea) Dobrotić, born about 1841 at Veliki Lovrečan, Varaždin, Croatia, and her husband Franjo Korotaj?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 7, hint-samples.csv row 228, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-22 as a true match (issue #3621), correcting a 2026-10-21 resolution that read entry 22 of the page instead of entry 28: entry 28 of the 1871 Križovljan Radovečki baptism register is Jacobus, son of Franciscus Korotaj and Dorothea Dobrotić of Lovrečan, born 3 April 1871. The image reading was calibrated against entries 26 and 27 on the same page. The Kotoriba death-register label on the image is film-level metadata; every indexed entry on the page is an 1871 Križovljan Radovečki baptism.
